An application uses a change the next ti: An application uses a change the next time it starts. The command line (--lang) and the ULTRACANVAS_LANG variable override this setting for one start.
Every set an application's texts come fr: Every set an application's texts come from in one grid - its own set, the base sets it takes and the standard set - for any application and any language. A save goes into the source tree when the catalogues are writable, else into the UltraCanvas settings folder, where a running application picks it up; the status line says where.

The languages come from media/locale/ in: The languages come from media/locale/ in the applications' resources and from locale/ in the UltraCanvas settings folder, where a translator puts a draft to see it in the real window.
